# Native fader visual references

These four 72x72 crops come from the owner's supplied screenshot
`codex-clipboard-a23bddb6-2aef-4eaa-a7f5-c89a059d71db.png` (2026-10-25),
showing Elgato Volume Controller. They are third-party UI reference material
for regression comparison only, not plugin artwork or included in distribution.
Do not regenerate them from this project's renderer.

Crop origins (x, y): left (26,90), right (154,90), upper (282,90), lower (282,184).
No scaling, color adjustment, or shape editing was applied. Rounded host key
corners remain in the crops and are excluded explicitly by the comparison.
See `docs/gain-button.md` for the measured geometry and test tolerances.
